posts.author: Fr4ncioh
posts.body:
Hello,
This is a cry for help from to the developers that made the RPG Maker MZ engine or generally anyone that can help me with this.
I have low eye sight that requires me to set my monitor resolution to 150% zoom in Windows for accessibility along with other things. I previously used RPG Maker MV without any issues, but after switching to MZ, I found the client to be completely unusable at this zoom level.
The UI of the engine becomes blurry, and many windows are pushed out of reach, making it impossible to save, apply, discard changes, minimize, or even close the window. This effectively prevents me from using the engine.
Setting my monitor resolution to 100% makes the engine work fine, but not the windows OS as a whole, so that's not an option.
Is there any way to fix this issue or improve compatibility with display scaling? Any help would be greatly appreciated, i'm really desperate.
Thank you.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Just to clarify:
You want this to apply to playing other people's games, not the ones you develop yourself?
Because while I can think of several solutions if you have developer access, none of those will apply to deployed and encrypted games.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
OK - sorry I completly misread your post at first then.
And what I thought as possible solutions also doesn't apply to the editor, those were for games.
It is almost impossible to change the editor itself.
Both MV and MZ use the so-called Qt engine for their framework however, and there was one single forum user who managed to use that framework to make changes to the MV-editor.
Unfortunately that wasn't easy and I haven't heard or seen any post of that user in years - I don't even remember the name.
You can try to find the handful of posts about modifying the MV editor and then see if you can still contact that user, but as far as I know that was the only success ever in changing the editor.
